## Description

PREGNANCY_EPISODE per patient: last menstrual period, dating scan date and gestation at the scan, due date (LMP + 280 days, or from the scan when the scan differs by more than the dating rule), gravida, para, abortions and living children, blood group and Rh, and an outcome that closes it. Gestation today is worked out from the due date in the facility time zone. Antenatal contacts (8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 38, 40 weeks) show as done, today or to come, linked to visits. Danger signs counselled are recorded with who and when. The chart shows the pregnancy module and the life stage becomes Pregnancy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Due date and gestation are tested: LMP 19 May 2026 gives due date 23 Feb 2027 and 24 w 3 d on 06 Nov 2026.
- [ ] **AC2.** A scan date that moves the due date records which date is used and why; the earlier date is kept.
- [ ] **AC3.** Only one open pregnancy per patient; closing it needs an outcome and the life stage returns to adult.
- [ ] **AC4.** Pregnancy data is SensitiveHealth, tenant isolated (EF filter and RLS) and never in logs or URLs.
- [ ] **AC5.** shortcut: the dating rule and the contact plan are the WHO model and wait for clinical sign-off.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
